name: Magmin

actions.name: Ember Spit
actions.effect: Ranged attack. Target catches fire, taking 1d6 fire at the start of each turn until they spend 1 action to extinguish.

reactions.name: Death Burst
reactions.effect: When the Magmin is reduced to 0 HP, it explodes. All creatures within 3m take 3d6 fire damage (PHYS save for half). Flammable objects in the area ignite.

traits.name: Ignited Illumination
traits.desc: The Magmin sheds bright light in a 3m radius and dim light for an additional 3m.

traits.name: Heated Body
traits.desc: Any creature that touches the Magmin or hits it with a melee attack from within reach takes 1d6 fire damage.

lore: Magmins are small, impish fire elementals composed of hardened magma with a molten core. They are gleefully destructive, setting everything they can reach ablaze. When they die, they go out with a bang.
